title: Tanker hit in Strait of Hormuz, engine room damaged
excerpt: UKMTO confirms a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on 4 October, with further explosions reported off Yemen and in the Gulf of Aden.
x_post: A tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on 4 October, damaging the engine room, UKMTO said. Explosions were also reported off Yemen and in the Gulf of Aden. #MaritimeSecurity #StraitOfHormuz #RedSea #UKMTO
